description: Resources V2 initial-inventory search acceleration (AIRE #121). Inert until a row in nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration is enabled with an authorisation reference.

preState.description: reserve_directory_search is exactly the reviewed pre-release definition (md5 9d6350c1...)
neither the acceleration table nor its gate function exists yet
preState.sql: select to_regclass('public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration') is null and to_regprocedure('public.directory_inventory_acceleration_allows(text,text,text,bigint)') is null as ok

identity.description: AIRE standing policy table, run table with execution_phase, receipt table and the migration ledger exist
identity.sql: select to_regclass('public.nexus_directory_standing_policy') is not null and to_regclass('public.nexus_directory_search_receipt') is not null and to_regclass('supabase_migrations.schema_migrations') is not null and exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='nexus_directory_run' and column_name='execution_phase') and exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='nexus_directory_standing_policy' and column_name='initial_inventory_completed_at') as ok
select exists(select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='service_role') as ok

identity.description: reserve_directory_search exists, is SECURITY DEFINER and carries the daily ceiling exactly once, or the gate (already installed)
identity.sql: select p.prosecdef and (pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) like '%directory_inventory_acceleration_allows%' or (length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))-length(replace(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'if daily_count>=(case when a.provider_id=''brave-web-search''','')))/length('if daily_count>=(case when a.provider_id=''brave-web-search''')=1) as ok from pg_proc p where p.oid='public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)'::regprocedure

preserve.description: every standing policy row, complete content of every column (so every policy hash)
preserve.sql: select md5(count(*)::text||':'||coalesce(string_agg(md5(p::text),',' order by p.policy_id),'')) as snapshot from public.nexus_directory_standing_policy p

preserve.description: the configuration of every search allowance (provider, policy, limits, prices, enabled, verification and expiry; counters excluded because AIRE keeps running)
preserve.sql: select md5(count(*)::text||':'||coalesce(string_agg(md5(concat_ws('|',a.allowance_id,a.provider_id,a.policy_id,a.allocated_micro_usd,a.price_per_request_micro_usd,a.max_requests,a.enabled,a.requires_run,a.verified_at,a.expires_at,a.verification_ref)),',' order by a.allowance_id),'')) as snapshot from public.nexus_directory_search_allowance a

verify.description: acceleration table exists with row level security on and exactly the default-off state (no enabled row)
verify.sql: select to_regclass('public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration') is not null and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration'::regclass) and not exists(select 1 from public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration where enabled) as ok

verify.description: reserve_directory_search calls the acceleration gate and still carries its budget, role and run-cap guards

finalVerify.description: acceleration table exists with row level security on
finalVerify.sql: select to_regclass('public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration') is not null and (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration'::regclass) as ok

finalVerify.description: reserve_directory_search calls the acceleration gate and still carries its budget, role and run-cap guards

finalVerify.sql:
select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.directory_inventory_acceleration_allows(text,text,text,bigint)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.directory_inventory_acceleration_allows(text,text,text,bigint)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.directory_inventory_acceleration_allows(text,text,text,bigint)','execute')
   and not exists(select 1 from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') as ok from pg_proc p where p.oid='public.directory_inventory_acceleration_allows(text,text,text,bigint)'::regprocedure

finalVerify.description: public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb) is still executable by service_role only
finalVerify.sql:
select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)','execute')
   and not exists(select 1 from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') as ok from pg_proc p where p.oid='public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)'::regprocedure

finalVerify.description: acceleration table: service_role may read and write, anon and authenticated have no access
finalVerify.sql: select has_table_privilege('service_role','public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration','select,insert,update') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.nexus_directory_inventory_acceleration','select') as ok

verify.description: reserve_directory_search is restored to the reviewed pre-release definition
the acceleration gate function is gone and no enabled control row can matter

   and not exists(select 1 from aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') as ok from pg_proc p where p.oid='public.reserve_directory_search(jsonb)'::regprocedure
